title: araujia odorata
intro: Araujia odorata, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a flowering plant native to the Americas. The health benefits of Devil's Claw include relief from pain, inflammation, and digestive issues, making it a popular natural remedy. The therapeutic actions of Devil's Claw are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and pain through its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of Devil's Claw include iridoid glycosides, particularly harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
